entries.13ca5e1fdc4b1b98: Rental of Party Dresses and Wedding Dresses
entries.16ac2496c51bf4be: A business that sells and rents gofuku and furisode, provides pre-ceremony photo shoots for Coming-of-Age Ceremonies, dressing and makeup on the day of the ceremony, and operates kimono-wearing classes. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥14,984 million.
entries.22f489a1d24a72cc: Ginza Ichiri and Mail Order Sales
entries.2955b9301aa820ca: Jewelry and traditional accessories such as zori sandals and bags
entries.3251466e60eb74a3: Planning, Design and Operation of Wedding Ceremonies and Receptions
entries.35faae923546695a: A company engaged in the Kimono Business, which sells and rents kimono and furisode and holds kimono dressing classes, and the Wedding Business, which operates wedding venues in Japan and China.
entries.4eb3530cdc0eaffb: It operates the kimono-wearing class “Ichiru” and, in addition to guidance on how to wear kimono, provides opportunities to wear kimono through outings in kimono and regeneration through shikkai.
entries.639c75393edaf149: It operates “Camelot Hills” in Saitama Prefecture, “Glastonia” and “Hyakkaro” in Nagoya City, and “Neos Mirabel” in Fuefuki City, Yamanashi Prefecture, and it also operates the photo studio “Studio Merlin” in Kita-ku, Saitama City, Saitama Prefecture.
entries.a8f8a8a54d7a2a7c: In Shanghai, China, it operates two facilities of the Jiamei Lude Gaoduan Hunli Huiguan: the Daning store and the Hongqiao store.
entries.a9e88eff2167f4d2: Customers attending Coming-of-Age Ceremonies or graduation ceremonies
entries.b90128f47b58b831: Through its company-operated store “Ichikura” and its franchised and authorized dealer stores, it sells and rents gofuku, furisode and traditional accessories, and provides coordination and measurement tailored to customer requests. There are 108 permanent stores, of which 34 are franchised stores.
entries.cb64e0ef29a0b25f: At “Ginza Ichiri”, it sells kimono sourced directly from production-region workshops across Japan and shipped directly from those regions, and the mail-order site “Ichiri Mall” also sells kimono and traditional accessories and provides shikkai services.
entries.f3b95b64ea35a619: A business that operates wedding venues in Japan and in Shanghai, China, and handles planning, design and operation of wedding ceremonies and receptions, as well as dress rental. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥4,462 million.
